tutor-profile.title: Tutor Profile — UniSkilled
tutor-profile.get-your-verified-badge: Get your Verified badge — verify your university email →
tutor-profile.add-the-exact-courses: Add the exact courses you passed and where. Students search for their own course, so this is how they find you.
tutor-profile.no-reviews-yet-only: No reviews yet. Only students who completed a paid session with this tutor on UniSkilled can leave a review.
tutor-profile.had-a-lesson-with: Had a lesson with this tutor?
tutor-profile.each-lesson-can-be: Each lesson can be rated once, by the student who had it. Rate your finished lessons from your dashboard.
tutor-profile.youre-not-charged-until: You're not charged until the tutor accepts. Payment is held for 48 hours after the session.
tutor-profile.your-grade-is-optional: Your grade is optional and shown as "self-reported". Only add details that are true; false course or grade details can lead to removal from UniSkilled.

tutor-profile.after-adding-dont-forget: After adding, don't forget to click Save below to actually store it on your profile.
tutor-profile.lessons-take-place-in: Lessons take place in the built-in UniSkilled classroom, so no link is needed. Optionally add a Zoom or Google Meet link: it is only shown inside the classroom as a backup if the connection has problems.
tutor-profile.test-the-link-in: 💡 Test the link in a private browser window after saving, so you know it opens your room.
tutor-profile.meta.description: View this university-verified tutor's subjects, rate, availability and reviews, and request a session on UniSkilled.
